set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Parallel rows
set.stimulus:
Eight persons sit in two parallel rows of four persons each, with equal distance between adjacent persons. Persons in Row 1 face south and persons in Row 2 face north, so each person in Row 1 faces a person in Row 2. S, T, U and V sit in Row 1, and B, C, D and E sit in Row 2, not necessarily in the same order. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. T sits second to the left of U.
2. T sits to the immediate right of V.
3. S sits to the immediate left of U.
4. B sits third to the left of C.
5. D sits to the immediate right of B.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits second to the left of C?

steps: Start with clues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: together they fix T, U, V, S, B, C and D.
E takes the only seat left.
The chain fits into the row in only one way.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — U, S, T, V; Row 2 — B, D, E, C.
C faces north, so C's right is towards the east end.
Second to the left of C: E → D — answer **D**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.

questions.prompt: Who sits to the immediate right of E?

steps: Start with clues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: together they fix T, U, V, S, B, C and D.
E takes the only seat left.
The chain fits into the row in only one way.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — U, S, T, V; Row 2 — B, D, E, C.
E faces north, so E's right is towards the east end.
Immediately to the right of E: C — answer **C**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.
solution.trap: D is immediately to the left — counting in the wrong direction gives this option.

steps: Start with clues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: together they fix T, U, V, S, B, C and D.

Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — U, S, T, V; Row 2 — B, D, E, C.
Between C and B sit 2 persons — **Two**.

solution.trap: Three comes from counting one of the two named persons.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: What is the position of D with respect to C?

steps: Start with clues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: together they fix T, U, V, S, B, C and D.
E takes the only seat left.
The chain fits into the row in only one way.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — U, S, T, V; Row 2 — B, D, E, C.

D sits second to the left of E
C is an immediate neighbour of S
S sits to the immediate right of U

Third to the right of Chetan: Deepak → Nitin → Jyoti — answer **Jyoti**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Parallel rows
set.stimulus:
Eight persons sit in two parallel rows of four persons each, with equal distance between adjacent persons. Persons in Row 1 face south and persons in Row 2 face north, so each person in Row 1 faces a person in Row 2. A, B, C and D sit in Row 1, and P, Q, R and S sit in Row 2, not necessarily in the same order. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. B sits second to the right of D.
2. S sits second to the left of R.
3. P sits second to the left of Q.
4. D sits third to the left of A.
5. R sits second from the right end of the row.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits to the immediate left of B?

steps: Start with clues 1, 4, 5, 2 and 3: together they fix B, D, A, R, S, P and Q.
C takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — A, B, C, D; Row 2 — S, P, R, Q.
B faces south, so B's right is towards the west end.
Immediately to the left of B: C — answer **C**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.
solution.trap: A is immediately to the right — counting in the wrong direction gives this option.

questions.subject: reasoning

Second to the left of S now: P → R — **R**.
solution.shortcut: Swap the two names on your diagram first; then count from the new seat.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is true according to the given arrangement?
options: B sits to the immediate left of A
D is an immediate neighbour of B

steps: Start with clues 1, 4, 5, 2 and 3: together they fix B, D, A, R, S, P and Q.
C takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — A, B, C, D; Row 2 — S, P, R, Q.
(A) A faces C — false.
(B) B sits to the immediate left of A — **true**.
(C) B faces A — false.
(D) D is an immediate neighbour of B — false.
(E) P faces Q — false.
solution.shortcut: Test each statement on the final diagram, not on the clue list.
solution.trap: A statement copied from a clue with one word changed (left ↔ right, second ↔ third) looks familiar but is wrong.
